answer_1.quote: We evaluate responses in four languages: English, French, Portuguese, and Russian. Instructions ... include tasks like write an email, give advice, suggest a recipe, etc.

answer_2.quote: We also introduce lightweight surface metrics: language correctness, spellcheck correctness, and relevance to the task (how often responses are relevant to their tasks, evaluated using LLama-2-chat-7B).

answer_3.quote: We conduct main evaluation using both manual predictions inspection ... and GPT-3.5 evaluation (on the full evaluation set).

answer_4.quote: Manual inspection of predictions was conducted by the native or fluent speakers employed at our research laboratory.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators are provided with an evaluation instruction describing six criteria (helpfulness, language correctness, fluency, factual accuracy, logical coherence, harmlessness) and scoring guidelines.
